title: A protocol for the differentiation of brown adipose progenitors derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells at a high efficiency with no gene transfer
protocol: Maintain undifferentiated hiPSC cells in hiPSC growth medium on 6-well-tissue-culture-grade plates.
Initiate differentiation of hiPSCs by floating cultivation to form embryoid bodies (EBs).
Change the hiPSC growth medium without FGF2 at day 3 and then change it daily until day 10.
Collect the medium containing EBs in a 15 ml conical tube for 15 minutes under the hood.
Spin the tubes briefly at low speed to increase the number of collected EBs.
Gently remove the supernatant, add fresh medium, and seed EBs back onto the 6-well-ultra-low attachment plates.
At day 10, plate EBs from one well of a 6-well-ultra-low-attachment plate onto one gelatin-coated well of a 6-well-tissue-grade-culture plate in hiPSC growth medium.
Change the medium every day.
Wash EB outgrowths twice with PBS at day 17.
Replace the washing solution with hiPSC growth medium after removing PBS.
Change the medium every day for a week following step 6.
Passage the cells using trypsin at day 24.
Split one well of a 6-well plate into a 10 cm tissue culture grade plate.
Maintain cells in adipose progenitor proliferation medium post-passage, marking this as passage number 1.
Split cells with a 1:3 split ratio when reaching 80% confluence.
Repeat the splitting step until achieving a cell population with homogenous CD73 labelling determined by FACS analysis.
Characterize BAPs in detail using FACS analysis for CD105+/CD90+/CD140a+/CD31-/CD45- markers and real-time PCR for PAX3, DIO2, absence of HOXC8, HOXC9, and HOXA5 expression.
Plate BAPs at a high density of 1-5x10^4 cells/cm^2 in adipose progenitor proliferation medium.
When cells reach confluence, determine it as day 0 for differentiation.
Wash cells once with PBS when cells are confluent.
Change the adipose progenitor proliferation medium to hiPSC-BAP differentiation medium.
Change the hiPSC-BAP differentiation medium three days after initiation, omitting IBMX and dexamethasone.
Change the BAP differentiation medium weekly, omitting IBMX and dexamethasone.
